objective: Find H100 NVL microbatch throughput/memory trend using 8 control then 16,24,32 and conditional 40 at context 1024
memory_guard: predict <=90% of H100 total VRAM and leave >=7 GiB; after b32 require >=5% improvement over b24 for conditional b40
note: Larger effective batches are benchmarks only, not an accepted learning-rate/batch training recipe. No checkpoints/evaluation.
